title: Cyclone Arnab lashes India coast, no deaths reported
paragraphs: BHUBANESWAR, India: Ferocious winds and torrential rain lashed India's southeastern coast after a cyclone made landfall on Wednesday (Oct 28), but there were no initial reports of deaths, a top official said.

Cyclone Arnab hit southestern Andhra Pradesh state as a "very severe cyclonic storm", with winds of 115kmh to 125kmh and gusts reaching 140kmh, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) said in an update at 0830 am (11am Singapore time).
It warned of flash floods along the coast between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam.
